    # k is 1-indexed, target_index is 0-indexed
    target_index = k - 1
    target_coin = row[target_index]
    
    # 1. Find the maximal contiguous monochromatic run containing target_index
    
    # Find start index i
    i = target_index
    while i > 0 and row[i - 1] == target_coin:
        i -= 1
        
    # Find end index j
    j = target_index
    while j < L - 1 and row[j + 1] == target_coin:
        j += 1
        
    subsequence = row[i:j+1]
    
    # 2. Identify remaining coins and build the new row
    
    # Coins before the subsequence
    prefix = row[:i]
    # Coins after the subsequence
    suffix = row[j+1:]
    
    # Remaining coins in order
    remaining = prefix + suffix
    
    # 3. Move subsequence to the left end
    new_row = subsequence + remaining

def check_stabilization(row):
    """Checks if the row is stable (at most one adjacent pair of different metals)."""
